about_the_game:
The digital artbook for All in Abyss: Judge the Fake

Contains 5 pdf files, for: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.

To access the artbook

1. In your Steam library, right click『All in Abyss: Judge the Fake』, and select "Property"

2. Ensure the artbook is installed from the property window of "DLC"

3. In your Steam library, right click『All in Abyss: Judge the Fake』click on "Manage" > "Browse local files"

4. File Explorer will open

5. The artbook will be located inside the「OFFICIAL DESIGN WORKS」folder

*The contents of this digital artbook are the same as that of the "OFFICIAL DESIGN WORKS" in "OFFICIAL DESIGN WORKS AND MUSIC PLAYER" contained in the Nintendo Switch/PlayStation5 Version "All in Abyss: Judge the Fake - Digital Deluxe Edition"

For those who own the above products, please be wary of duplicate purchases
